meta.title: 문장 뒤로 이동
meta.note: 정답·해설 p.45의 대표 Q01~Q02 원문과 목적어 뒤 이동·삽입절·to부정사 수식 구조를 대조해 대표 source-aligned QA 세트로 변환함.

items.sentence: The architect made clear his views on the city reform plan, which he thought was not in the best interests of the public and could harm the landscape of the whole city.
items.prompt: made와 긴 목적어 his views ... 사이에 놓인 목적격보어를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: 원래 <make + O + C>에서 긴 목적어 his views on the city reform plan이 뒤로 이동해 목적격보어 clear가 먼저 나타난 구조입니다.
items.memory: 긴 목적어가 뒤로 이동하면 O-C 순서가 겉으로 뒤바뀔 수 있음

items.sentence: The architect made clear his views on the city reform plan, which he thought was not in the best interests of the public and could harm the landscape of the whole city.
items.explanation: which 뒤의 he thought는 삽입절입니다. 이를 걷어내면 which was not ... and could harm ...의 관계사절 구조가 선명해집니다.

items.sentence: The architect made clear his views on the city reform plan, which he thought was not in the best interests of the public and could harm the landscape of the whole city.
items.prompt: made clear his views ... 부분을 기본 어순으로 복원한 것을 고르세요.
choices: made his views on the city reform plan clear
made clear on the city reform plan his views
items.answer: made his views on the city reform plan clear
items.explanation: 기본 어순은 make + 목적어 his views ... + 목적격보어 clear입니다.

items.sentence: Researchers found in a survey of 542 households in England that the beach was rated a more enjoyable place to visit than national parks, museums, or amusement parks.
items.prompt: found의 긴 목적어로서 부사구 뒤로 이동한 that절 전체를 드래그하세요.
items.answer: that the beach was rated a more enjoyable place to visit than national parks, museums, or amusement parks
items.explanation: 긴 목적어 that절이 동사 found 바로 뒤가 아니라 부사구 in a survey ... England 뒤에 놓인 구조입니다.

items.sentence: Researchers found in a survey of 542 households in England that the beach was rated a more enjoyable place to visit than national parks, museums, or amusement parks.
items.prompt: to visit가 직접 수식하는 명사를 고르세요.
items.explanation: to visit는 앞의 명사 a more enjoyable place를 수식해 ‘방문하기에 더 즐거운 장소’라는 의미를 만듭니다.
